key_insight: HealthAgentBench is a realistic, end-to-end healthcare agent benchmark that shows today’s frontier AI agents still struggle with long-horizon clinical workflows.
clinical_relevance: This benchmark helps identify where AI agents may or may not be ready to support complex healthcare tasks such as EHR research pipelines and medical imaging workflows.
method: Created 54 agentic healthcare tasks across 7 categories
Built a unique environment for each task to mimic real patient-journey workflows
Evaluated frontier agents with a single final task success rate metric
evidence_signal: Across 54 tasks in 7 categories, the strongest and most cost-effective agent (Codex GPT-5.5) achieved only about 42% overall success, indicating substantial room for improvement.
watch_item: Benchmark performance may not directly translate to safe real-world clinical deployment, especially for tasks requiring complex search, compositional reasoning, or medical imaging interpretation.
paper_title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
